text: Decouple the frontend from the orchestrator microservice: the UI ships and runs on its own and talks to the orchestrator only through its documented HTTP API.
New component repo agents-web (TypeScript), history of agent-orchestrator/frontend kept.
One host lab.szymonrichert.pl with ingress path routing: UI at /, orchestrator /api, one prefix per later service.
Runtime config.json listing the backends, set by the chart; a backend's UI entries appear only when it is configured.
nginx-unprivileged static image for the UI.
Releases, pin bumps and the helmfile apply plus smoke are tasks of this epic, as in agent-init-scripts.
Headless parity: the orchestrator API stays documented and tested API-only; the kind e2e keeps passing after the split.
Runs after agent-init-scripts and cluster-scaling have merged and moves the frontend as it stands then, including their UI.
